24k-blunt: 24K takes its name from a purity measure, and it is the one Gold Strain Series release that carries no partner mark and no flavor name. This is a single 1.5g Moon Rock blunt built from flower, live resin, and diamonds, rolled in a 100% tobacco-free wrap and marked Indica on the pack. Live resin is extracted from plants frozen at harvest instead of dried, which keeps more of the terpenes that define how a strain smells and tastes.
blue-dream-blunt: Blue Dream is the most requested name in cannabis, and this Gold Strain Series blunt holds it to a standard: familiar blueberry character meeting earthy pine, with a recognizable cannabis finish. One 1.5g Moon Rock blunt of flower, live resin, and diamonds, rolled in a tobacco-free wrap and marked Sativa on the pack. The live resin coat comes from plants frozen at harvest rather than dried, the method Presidential uses to preserve more of the terpenes behind a strain's smell and taste.
cereal-milk-blunt: Cereal Milk brings a creamy profile known for sweet milk and vanilla notes to the Rose Gold Connoisseur Series, the top tier of the Presidential catalog. The 1.5g Moon Rock blunt combines flower, live rosin, and diamonds in a tobacco-free wrap, and the pack marks it Hybrid. Live rosin is made without chemical solvents, using only ice water, heat, and pressure, which is why connoisseurs prize it as a pure expression of the plant.
cherry-gelato-blunt: Cherry Gelato is Presidential's collaboration with ROVE, pairing a sweet cherry and creamy Gelato profile in which dark cherry arrives first and something creamier settles beneath it. This 1.5g Moon Rock blunt is built from flower, live resin, and diamonds, rolled tobacco-free and marked Hybrid. The ROVE mark is printed on the front of the pack, which places this blunt among the small number of Presidential releases that carry a partner's name.
cosmic-cookies-blunt: Cosmic Cookies keeps the doughy sweetness of the Cookies family and sets something colder and more mineral beneath it. As a Rose Gold Connoisseur Series blunt it carries flower, live rosin, and diamonds in a single 1.5g tobacco-free roll, marked Hybrid on the pack. The solventless live rosin at its center is the slower, more deliberate way to make a concentrate: craftsmanship over volume.
crescendo-blunt: Crescendo is built as the name promises, with a reported profile that moves from earthy diesel into berry and citrus, gathering layer upon layer rather than opening at full volume. The Gold Strain Series blunt holds 1.5g of flower, live resin, and diamonds in a tobacco-free wrap, and the pack marks it Sativa. It suits buyers who want fruit alongside a gassy finish in one finished roll.
galactic-gas-blunt: Galactic Gas is for the fuel-and-spice enthusiast, with a strain profile reported as pungent gas, pine, and spicy herbs. One 1.5g Moon Rock blunt brings that selection into flower, live resin, and diamonds, rolled in a tobacco-free wrap and marked Hybrid. Its pack is the one in the Gold Strain Series that leaves the moon behind and goes to open space.
gods-gift-blunt: God's Gift belongs to the Presidential names that arrive with weight already attached rather than describing a flavor. It is a Rose Gold Connoisseur Series blunt: 1.5g of flower, live rosin, and diamonds in a 100% tobacco-free wrap, marked Indica on the pack. Rose Gold is the tier where the house puts its most selective work, and its live rosin is made with ice water, heat, and pressure and no chemical solvents.
gorilla-goo-blunt: Gorilla Goo is sticky, resinous, and named with complete honesty, with reported sour fuel, pine, and chocolate notes behind a rich, gassy character. This 1.5g Gold Strain Series blunt carries flower, live resin, and diamonds in a tobacco-free wrap, marked Hybrid on the pack. It is the pick for the buyer who wants a robust strain profile with the full three-layer Presidential build underneath.
king-louis-blunt: King Louis leans into the classic OG profile of pine, lemon, earth, and a pronounced fuel note, and it is the Presidential release made in collaboration with VLAD TV, with the partner's name printed on the front of the pack. The 1.5g Moon Rock blunt pairs flower with live resin and a diamond finish, rolled in a tobacco-free wrap and marked Indica. It is a selection for consumers who appreciate a traditional kush character.
nyc-diesel-blunt: NYC Diesel brings grapefruit-like citrus and unmistakable fuel notes together, the contrast between a bright citrus nose and a deeper diesel character. The Gold Strain Series blunt holds 1.5g of flower infused with live resin and finished with diamonds in a tobacco-free wrap, marked Hybrid on the pack. A strain named for a city that is now one of Presidential's own markets gives retailers there an easy story to tell.
papaya-punch-blunt: Papaya Punch is flavor-forward by design, with a tropical fruit and berry profile for people who gravitate toward juicy fruit character. The 1.5g Moon Rock blunt builds that profile on flower, live resin, and diamonds, rolled tobacco-free and marked Sativa. It is one of the brightest packs Presidential prints, and the product underneath is built to the same standard as the rest of the Gold Strain Series.
pink-cookies-blunt: Pink Cookies is the cookie lineage at its most decadent: a sweet vanilla profile balanced by earth and citrus, rich without tipping into cloying. One 1.5g Gold Strain Series blunt of flower, live resin, and diamonds, rolled in a tobacco-free wrap and marked Indica. Choose it for creamy strain character delivered in a finished roll.
presidential-og-blunt: Presidential OG is the house strain, and when a house puts its own name on a product it carries the crest and nothing else. This 1.5g Moon Rock blunt is the live resin and diamonds build, the heavier construction of the two Presidential-named packs, rolled in a tobacco-free wrap and marked Hybrid. It is the Gold Strain Series selection for buyers who want the Presidential name itself on the shelf.
rainbow-belts-blunt: Rainbow Belts balances sweet fruit and citrus with a diesel edge, a candy-store name that does not get a candy-store product. The 1.5g blunt carries flower, live resin, and diamonds in a tobacco-free wrap and is marked Indica on the pack. It is the most playful pack in the Gold Strain Series and a choice for people who enjoy fruity and gassy notes in the same roll.
sfv-og-blunt: SFV OG is the San Fernando Valley distilled: lemon, pine, and earthy diesel from the resinous citrus-and-pine side of the OG family. One 1.5g Moon Rock blunt of flower, live resin, and diamonds, rolled tobacco-free and marked Hybrid. A California classic that never required reinvention, kept honest in the Gold Strain Series.
skywalker-blunt: Skywalker is the ROVE collaboration that runs across every format in the Presidential line, and ROVE describes the profile through blueberry, tropical, and earthy notes with a clean, almost cool finish. The 1.5g Moon Rock blunt carries flower, live resin, and diamonds in a tobacco-free wrap, marked Indica, with the ROVE mark printed on the front. It is the profile people reach for when they already know exactly what they want.
waui-blunt: Waui brings a pineapple-led tropical profile to the Presidential and ROVE collaboration, bright and sweet where most of the Gold Strain Series goes dense. The 1.5g Moon Rock blunt is flower, live resin, and diamonds in a tobacco-free wrap, marked Sativa, with ROVE on the front of the pack. It is the choice for people who enjoy sweet tropical cannabis flavor in a finished blunt.
wedding-cake-blunt: Wedding Cake brings a profile known for vanilla, sweetness, and earthy citrus to the Rose Gold Connoisseur Series. The 1.5g Moon Rock blunt pairs flower with live rosin and diamonds in a tobacco-free wrap, marked Indica on the pack. A dessert name does not get a lighter build: the solventless rosin inside is the most selective work in the Presidential catalog.
white-walker-blunt: White Walker sits at the cold end of the Presidential catalog, and it is a different product from Skywalker despite the two names sitting close on a menu. The Rose Gold Connoisseur Series blunt holds 1.5g of flower, live rosin, and diamonds in a 100% tobacco-free wrap, marked Sativa on the pack. Live rosin is made with ice water, heat, and pressure and no solvents, the refined and intentional lane of the line.
xj13-blunt: XJ-13 is a name that sounds like a specification, and the pack prints its parentage as Jack Herer and G13 Haze. Its reported citrus, lemon, and pine profile is bright and precise over an earthy cannabis base, carried here in a 1.5g Moon Rock blunt of flower, live resin, and diamonds, tobacco-free and marked Sativa. Engineering, expressed as a Gold Strain Series blunt.
xxx-blunt: XXX requires no adjectives: a woodsy citrus profile with a classic earthy cannabis character, and a name that lets the pack do the rest. The 1.5g Moon Rock blunt is built from flower, live resin, and diamonds in a tobacco-free wrap, marked Indica. No fruit on the label and no story about where the strain came from, just three letters and a build, the Gold Strain Series at its most direct.
24k-mini-blunt: The 24K Mini Blunt pack puts the purity-measure name into three 0.7g Moon Rock mini blunts, 2.1g in total. Each is the same flower, live resin, and diamonds build as the full-size blunt, in a 100% tobacco-free wrap, with the pack marked Indica. A mini blunt is a smaller version of the same object, not a cheaper one.
cherry-gelato-mini-blunt: Three 0.7g Cherry Gelato mini blunts, 2.1g in all, carry the ROVE collaboration's sweet cherry and creamy Gelato profile in a pack built for three occasions or three people. Flower, live resin, and diamonds in 100% tobacco-free wraps, marked Hybrid, with ROVE printed on the front. The build does not change between formats; only the size and the count do.
gorilla-goo-mini-blunt: Gorilla Goo's reported sour fuel, pine, and chocolate notes come as a three-pack here: three 0.7g Moon Rock mini blunts, 2.1g in total. Each is flower coated in live resin and finished with diamonds, tobacco-free, with the pack marked Hybrid. It is the format decision for a buyer who wants the sticky, resinous strain in a size that spreads across several occasions.
pink-cookies-mini-blunt: Pink Cookies in a three-pack: three 0.7g mini blunts, 2.1g in total, carrying the sweet vanilla profile balanced by earth and citrus. Flower, live resin, and diamonds in 100% tobacco-free wraps, marked Indica on the pack. The crescent on the front carries a 3, and the decadent cookie character inside is unchanged from the single blunt.
presidential-og-mini-blunt: The house strain in its three-pack: three 0.7g Presidential OG Moon Rock mini blunts, 2.1g in total. Flower, live resin, and diamonds in tobacco-free wraps, with the pack marked Hybrid and the Presidential crest doing the talking. For retailers who want the Presidential name in a smaller size that one pack can share across three people.
skywalker-mini-blunt: Skywalker's ROVE collaboration reaches the mini blunt format with three 0.7g Moon Rock mini blunts, 2.1g in total, each built from flower, live resin, and diamonds in a 100% tobacco-free wrap. The pack is marked Indica and prints the ROVE mark on the front. Blueberry, tropical, and earthy notes, in a pack sized for more than one occasion.
waui-mini-blunt: Waui's pineapple-led tropical profile in a three-pack: three 0.7g mini blunts, 2.1g in total, made with ROVE and marked Sativa. Each mini blunt is flower, live resin, and diamonds in a 100% tobacco-free wrap. Island lineage, island temperament, in a format that gives one pack three separate occasions.
xj13-mini-blunt: XJ-13's citrus, lemon, and pine profile, with Jack Herer and G13 Haze printed as its parentage on the pack, arrives as three 0.7g Moon Rock mini blunts, 2.1g in total. Flower, live resin, and diamonds in tobacco-free wraps, marked Sativa. The same precise, citrus-forward strain, divided into three.
xxx-mini-blunt: XXX Mini Blunts: three at 0.7g each, 2.1g in total, each one flower, live resin, and diamonds in a 100% tobacco-free wrap, marked Indica. The woodsy citrus profile and the three-letter name are unchanged; the crescent on the front carries a 3 rather than a 1. Three separate occasions from one pack, or one pack across three people.
24k-mini-pre-roll: 24K Mini Prerolls hold three 0.5g Moon Rock mini pre-rolls, 1.5g in total, under the name Presidential takes from a purity measure. Each is flower, live resin, and diamonds, with the pack marked Indica. It is the Gold Strain Series name with no partner mark and no flavor name, in its smallest format.
cherry-gelato-mini-pre-roll: Cherry Gelato's dark cherry and creamy Gelato profile, made with ROVE, comes as three 0.5g Moon Rock mini pre-rolls, 1.5g in total. Flower, live resin, and diamonds in each, with the pack marked Hybrid and the ROVE mark on the front. A dessert strain that carries like a strain, now in a three-pack.
gorilla-goo-mini-pre-roll: Gorilla Goo Mini Prerolls: three 0.5g Moon Rock mini pre-rolls, 1.5g in total, marked Hybrid on the pack. Each roll is flower, live resin, and diamonds carrying the strain's reported sour fuel, pine, and chocolate notes. Unrefined entirely on purpose, in the smallest Presidential format.
pink-cookies-mini-pre-roll: Pink Cookies' sweet, doughy profile in three 0.5g Moon Rock mini pre-rolls, 1.5g in total. Flower, live resin, and diamonds in each roll, with the pack marked Indica. The Gold Strain Series' most indulgent name, sized so one pack covers three occasions.
presidential-og-mini-pre-roll: Presidential OG Mini Prerolls carry the house name on three 0.5g Moon Rock mini pre-rolls, 1.5g in total. Each is the live resin and diamonds build on flower, with the pack marked Hybrid. Where other packs compete with artwork, this one states a name, and the three-pack puts that name in the smallest size Presidential makes.
skywalker-mini-pre-roll: Skywalker Mini Prerolls bring the ROVE collaboration to three 0.5g Moon Rock mini pre-rolls, 1.5g in total, each flower, live resin, and diamonds. The pack is marked Indica and prints ROVE on the front. The earthy, full-spectrum profile with a clean finish, from the collaboration that runs across every format in the line.
waui-mini-pre-roll: Waui Mini Prerolls: three 0.5g Moon Rock mini pre-rolls, 1.5g in total, made with ROVE and marked Sativa. Flower, live resin, and diamonds in each, carrying the pineapple-led tropical profile. Bright and unhurried, the whole Gold Strain Series on holiday, in a three-pack.
xj13-mini-pre-roll: XJ-13 Mini Prerolls hold three 0.5g Moon Rock mini pre-rolls, 1.5g in total, with Jack Herer and G13 Haze printed on the pack as the strain's parentage. Each roll is flower, live resin, and diamonds, marked Sativa. Citrus-forward and clean, precise in a way most profiles never attempt.
xxx-mini-pre-roll: XXX Mini Pre Rolls: three 0.5g Moon Rock mini pre-rolls, 1.5g in total, each flower, live resin, and diamonds, marked Indica. The woodsy citrus profile and the three-letter name need no introduction. The Gold Strain Series at its most direct, in its smallest pack.
24k-pre-roll: The 24K Moon Rock Preroll is a single 1g roll of flower, live resin, and diamonds under the Gold Strain Series name taken from a purity measure. The pack is marked Indica and, like every 24K release, carries no partner mark and no flavor name. Live resin, extracted from plants frozen at harvest, is the ingredient that defines the Gold Strain Series.
blue-dream-pre-roll: Blue Dream's familiar blueberry character and earthy pine arrive here as a single 1g Moon Rock pre-roll of flower, live resin, and diamonds, prepared in rolling paper. The pack marks it Sativa and places it in the Gold Strain Series, where the most recognizable name in cannabis is sold as a strain, not as a flavor. A natural pick for people who enjoy berry notes with a recognizable cannabis finish.
cereal-milk-pre-roll: Cereal Milk's sweet milk and vanilla notes, the last inch in the bowl made deliberate, come as a 1g Rose Gold Connoisseur Series pre-roll. Flower, live rosin, and diamonds, prepared in rolling paper and marked Hybrid on the pack. It is the choice for connoisseurs who want the solventless rosin recipe in a finished roll.
cherry-gelato-pre-roll: Cherry Gelato Moon Rock Preroll: a single 1g roll from the Presidential and ROVE collaboration, with a sweet cherry and creamy Gelato profile for people drawn to fruit with a rounded character. Flower, live resin, and diamonds in rolling paper, marked Hybrid, with the ROVE mark printed on the front of the pack. A Gold Strain Series selection with a partner's name on it.
cosmic-cookies-pre-roll: Cosmic Cookies sends the Cookies family somewhere further out: doughy sweetness with something colder and more mineral beneath it. The 1g Moon Rock pre-roll pairs flower with live rosin and diamonds, prepared in rolling paper and marked Hybrid. Solventless craft applied to a familiar name, in the Rose Gold Connoisseur Series.
crescendo-pre-roll: Crescendo gathers layer upon layer, composition rather than noise, and this is its 1g Moon Rock pre-roll. Flower, live resin, and diamonds in a single finished roll, marked Sativa on the pack. A Gold Strain Series release for buyers who want a strain that builds rather than one that opens at full volume.
galactic-gas-pre-roll: Galactic Gas Moon Rock Preroll: 1g of flower, live resin, and diamonds carrying a strain profile reported as pungent gas, pine, and spicy herbs. Prepared in rolling paper and marked Hybrid on the pack. The deep-space pack is the Gold Strain Series going furthest out, and the roll inside is for the fuel-and-spice enthusiast.
gods-gift-pre-roll: God's Gift Moon Rock Preroll: a single 1g roll of flower, live rosin, and diamonds from the Rose Gold Connoisseur Series, marked Indica on the pack. The name describes how the strain is regarded rather than what it tastes like. Live rosin, made with ice water, heat, and pressure and no solvents, is the tier's defining ingredient.
gorilla-goo-pre-roll: Gorilla Goo's rich, gassy character, with reported sour fuel, pine, and chocolate notes, in a 1g Moon Rock pre-roll. Flower, live resin, and diamonds, prepared in rolling paper and marked Hybrid. Heavy on the palate and named with complete honesty, it is a Gold Strain Series pre-roll for people who want a robust strain in a ready-rolled format.
king-louis-pre-roll: King Louis Moon Rock Preroll carries the classic OG profile of pine, lemon, earth, and a pronounced fuel note in a single 1g roll. Flower infused with live resin and finished with diamonds, in rolling paper, marked Indica, with IN COLLABORATION WITH VLAD TV printed on the front. A Gold Strain Series pre-roll for consumers who appreciate a traditional kush character.
nyc-diesel-pre-roll: NYC Diesel in a 1g Moon Rock pre-roll: grapefruit-like citrus against unmistakable fuel notes, flower infused with live resin and finished with diamonds. The roll is prepared in rolling paper, and the pack marks the strain Hybrid. Choose it for the contrast between a bright citrus nose and a deeper diesel character, from a Gold Strain Series name tied to one of Presidential's own markets.
papaya-punch-pre-roll: Papaya Punch Moon Rock Preroll: a tropical fruit and berry profile in a single 1g roll of flower, live resin, and diamonds, marked Sativa. It is the selection for people who gravitate toward juicy fruit character while still wanting Presidential's layered construction. Fruit-led by design, and built to the same Gold Strain Series standard as everything beside it.
pink-cookies-pre-roll: Pink Cookies Moon Rock Preroll pairs a sweet vanilla profile, balanced by earth and citrus, with flower, live resin, and diamonds in a single 1g roll. Prepared in rolling paper and marked Indica on the pack. Creamy, decadent cookie character for consumers who want it ready-rolled, from the Gold Strain Series.
presidential-og-pre-roll: Presidential OG Moon Rock Preroll: 1g of flower, live resin, and diamonds under the house name, prepared in rolling paper and marked Hybrid. There is nowhere to hide on the strain that carries the Presidential crest, and this is the heavier of the two Presidential-named builds. The Gold Strain Series pre-roll for buyers who want the name itself.
rainbow-belts-pre-roll: Rainbow Belts Moon Rock Preroll: sweet fruit and citrus with a diesel edge in a single 1g roll of flower, live resin, and diamonds, marked Indica. Candy on the outside, house build underneath, prepared in rolling paper. For people who enjoy fruity and gassy notes in the same Gold Strain Series selection.
sfv-og-pre-roll: SFV OG Moon Rock Preroll brings lemon, pine, and earthy diesel to a single 1g roll of flower, live resin, and diamonds, marked Hybrid on the pack. Pine, fuel, and dry earth, a California classic kept honest. A Gold Strain Series pre-roll for consumers who appreciate the resinous citrus-and-pine side of the OG family.
skywalker-pre-roll: Skywalker Moon Rock Preroll: the ROVE collaboration in a single 1g roll of flower, live resin, and diamonds, prepared in rolling paper and marked Indica. ROVE describes the profile through blueberry, tropical, and earthy notes, with a clean, almost cool finish. The ROVE mark on the front of the pack makes it a partner release within the Gold Strain Series.
waui-pre-roll: Waui Moon Rock Preroll: a pineapple-led tropical profile from the Presidential and ROVE collaboration, in one 1g roll of flower, live resin, and diamonds. Marked Sativa, with ROVE printed on the front of the pack. Bright, tropical, and unhurried, sweet where most of the Gold Strain Series goes dense.
wedding-cake-pre-roll: Wedding Cake Moon Rock Preroll: vanilla, sweetness, and earthy citrus in a single 1g roll of flower, live rosin, and diamonds, prepared in rolling paper and marked Indica. The packaging goes loud and the product does not change: the solventless live rosin inside is the Rose Gold Connoisseur Series recipe. For people who enjoy creamy cannabis character and a rosin-based infusion.
white-walker-pre-roll: White Walker Moon Rock Preroll: a single 1g roll of flower, live rosin, and diamonds from the cold end of the Presidential catalog, marked Sativa. Not to be confused with Skywalker; this is a different product, in the Rose Gold Connoisseur Series. Live rosin is pressed from ice-water hash with heat and pressure, with no chemical solvents at any stage.
xj13-pre-roll: XJ-13 Moon Rock Preroll: citrus-forward and clean in a single 1g roll of flower, live resin, and diamonds, marked Sativa. The pack prints the parentage, Jack Herer and G13 Haze, beside the name. A Gold Strain Series pre-roll that is precise in a way most profiles never attempt.
xxx-pre-roll: XXX Moon Rock Preroll: a woodsy citrus profile with a classic earthy character in a single 1g roll of flower, live resin, and diamonds, marked Indica. No fruit on the label, no story about where the strain came from, just three letters and a build. The Gold Strain Series at its most direct, ready-rolled.
